description: Database: author supabase/migrations/047_dryer_hourly_edit_history.sql, a new additive, idempotent, re-runnable migration that re-creates the dryer hourly trigger FUNCTION tg_dryer_v2_hourly() (keeping the TRIGGER name trg_dryer_v2_hourly) so a genuine edit mints a NEW event_id (new sync event) while a no-op re-save and a replay produce the SAME event_id (on conflict (event_id) do nothing dedups), and the outbox payload carries the full per-field history so FEAT-003 can rebuild edited cells. Copied verbatim from migration 030's function with ONLY the design section 2.3 fingerprint/payload edits; every other attribute (language, security definer, `set search_path = public, pg_temp`, inner exception wrapper, unconditional return NEW) is byte-identical. No schema/RLS/realtime/view/unique-constraint change. Reads the JSONB contract defined by FEAT-001; implement after FEAT-001 so the __hist/__events shape is settled. Does NOT touch tg_dryer_v2_logs, QC triggers, dryer_logs, or the dryer_hourly_draft_active view.
steps: Read supabase/migrations/030_dryer_vertical_sheets.sql in full and copy the tg_dryer_v2_hourly() function body verbatim as the starting point. Preserve: v_keys allow-list (the 18 scalars + operator_name + maintenance); v_src_pk := NEW.dryer_type || '|' || NEW.log_date::text || '|' || coalesce(NEW.shift,'') || '|' || NEW.hour; event_id = md5('dryer_hour|' || v_src_pk || '|' || md5(v_fp)); the payload key 'date' = NEW.log_date::text (do NOT transpose source_pk's log_date column with the payload's date key); the exception wrapper `exception when others then raise warning ...` and final `return NEW`; and `set search_path = public, pg_temp` exactly.

Create supabase/migrations/047_dryer_hourly_edit_history.sql with a header comment: apply AFTER 030; scope = ONLY function tg_dryer_v2_hourly + trigger trg_dryer_v2_hourly; additive, idempotent, re-runnable; no schema/RLS/realtime/view/unique changes; the log_date-column vs date-payload-key note.

Per scalar field v_k compute v_hist := NEW.values->'__hist'->v_k and v_has_hist := (jsonb_typeof(v_hist)='array' and jsonb_array_length(v_hist)>0). Change the emit condition to: emit when nullif(trim(coalesce(NEW.values->>v_k,'')),'') is not null OR v_has_hist (design 2.3 Finding 1, so a field cleared-to-empty on an edit still reaches the payload). Build the fingerprint term as 030 does (v_fp := v_fp || v_k || '=' || coalesce(NEW.values->>v_k,'') || '@' || coalesce(v_tsobj->>v_k,'')) and append '#' || jsonb_array_length(v_hist)::text ONLY when v_has_hist, then append ';'. A never-edited field therefore reproduces 030's exact term byte-for-byte (backward compat N2).

Grow v_ts UNCONDITIONALLY for EVERY emitted field (design current-review Finding 1): move `v_ts := v_ts || jsonb_build_object(v_k, coalesce(v_tsobj->>v_k,''))` so it runs whenever the field emits (non-empty value OR v_has_hist), not only inside the non-empty-value branch as in 030. Set payload values[v_k] = NEW.values->>v_k (may be '' for a cleared field) and add hist[v_k] = v_hist to the payload whenever v_has_hist.

Maintenance branch: compute v_mhist := NEW.values->'__hist'->'maintenance' and v_mhas := (jsonb_typeof(v_mhist)='array' and jsonb_array_length(v_mhist)>0). Emit maintenance into the payload when at least one option is non-empty OR v_mhas (so a deselect-all edit still propagates and clears the stale cell). Fold the term exactly as 030 (maintenance=<object json>;) and append '#'||jsonb_array_length(v_mhist)::text ONLY when v_mhas. Attach hist.maintenance = v_mhist to the payload whenever v_mhas.

Fold the row-level __events trail NULL-SAFELY and ONLY when present: declare v_events jsonb := case when jsonb_typeof(NEW.values->'__events')='array' then NEW.values->'__events' else null end; and append the term only inside `if v_events is not null then v_fp := v_fp || '__events=' || jsonb_array_length(v_events)::text || '@' || coalesce(v_events->-1->>'ts','') || ';'; end if;`. When absent, contribute NOTHING so a pre-feature row's v_fp (and event_id) is byte-identical to 030 (design 2.3 Finding 1 / section 4). Keep operator_name in the fingerprint/payload exactly as 030 with NO #hist term. Do NOT read timestamp or __finalized into v_fp or the payload.

After the function, re-create the trigger by its REAL name: `drop trigger if exists trg_dryer_v2_hourly on dryer_hourly_draft;` then `create trigger trg_dryer_v2_hourly after insert or update on dryer_hourly_draft for each row execute function tg_dryer_v2_hourly();`. Do NOT add or drop any other trigger.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/migrations/047_dryer_hourly_edit_history.sql exists, parses as valid PL/pgSQL (balanced $$, create or replace function + drop/create trigger), and is re-runnable.
The function retains `security definer` and `set search_path = public, pg_temp` identical to 030, the inner exception wrapper, and `return NEW` (N4).
A pre-feature row (no __hist/__events) reproduces 030's exact v_fp so its event_id is unchanged (no #hist suffix, no __events term when arrays absent).

An edited field folds a #<hist_len> term and the payload carries hist[field]; a cleared-but-edited field still emits (value '' plus hist present) and grows ts[field]; maintenance emits on deselect-all when v_mhas.
Only tg_dryer_v2_hourly and trg_dryer_v2_hourly are created/dropped; no schema/RLS/realtime/view/unique change and no touch to tg_dryer_v2_logs or QC triggers.
verification: Static check: read 047 back and diff its function against 030 to confirm ONLY the section 2.3 fingerprint/payload lines changed and search_path/security-definer/exception/return NEW are byte-identical.
Confirm balanced dollar-quoting and that the drop/create trigger block uses trg_dryer_v2_hourly (trigger) with execute function tg_dryer_v2_hourly() (function).

ISOLATED ENVIRONMENT ONLY (N1 - cannot be done by the build; record as a checklist in findings): in a non-production Supabase project apply 018 -> 030 -> 047 in order, then assert: (a) a genuine edit yields a NEW event_id; (b) a no-op re-save and a replay of identical values yield the SAME event_id (on conflict dedups); (c) a pre-feature row's event_id is byte-identical to its pre-047 value.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Authored supabase/migrations/047_dryer_hourly_edit_history.sql: create or replace function tg_dryer_v2_hourly() copied verbatim from 030 with ONLY the design 2.3 fingerprint/payload edits, then drop/create trigger trg_dryer_v2_hourly (execute function tg_dryer_v2_hourly()). Scope touches ONLY that function + trigger. No schema/RLS/realtime/view/unique change; tg_dryer_v2_logs, QC triggers, dryer_logs untouched (the two dryer_logs/tg_dryer_v2_logs string matches are comment-only in the SCOPE header).

Edits applied vs 030 (design 2.3): (1) per scalar v_k compute v_hist := NEW.values->'__hist'->v_k and v_has_hist := (jsonb_typeof(v_hist)='array' and jsonb_array_length(v_hist)>0); emit when nullif(trim(coalesce(NEW.values->>v_k,'')),'') is not null OR v_has_hist. (2) fingerprint term built as 030 (v_k || '=' || coalesce(NEW.values->>v_k,'') || '@' || coalesce(v_tsobj->>v_k,'')) then append '#'||jsonb_array_length(v_hist)::text ONLY when v_has_hist, then ';'. A never-edited field reproduces 030's exact term byte-for-byte. (3) v_ts grown UNCONDITIONALLY for every emitted field (moved out of the non-empty branch). (4) payload values[v_k]=NEW.values->>v_k; new payload key 'hist' carries v_hst where hist[v_k]=v_hist whenever v_has_hist (and hist.maintenance=v_mhist whenever v_mhas). (5) maintenance: v_mhist/v_mhas, emit when any option non-empty OR v_mhas, fold 'maintenance='||object::text then '#'||len only when v_mhas. (6) row-level __events folded null-safely: v_events := case when jsonb_typeof(...)='array' then ... else null end; term appended only inside if v_events is not null. (7) operator_name kept exactly as 030 with NO #hist term; timestamp/__finalized NOT read into v_fp or payload. security definer, set search_path = public, pg_temp, inner exception wrapper (raise warning 'dryer_v2 hourly trigger: %', sqlerrm), and unconditional return NEW are byte-identical to 030 (N4).

VERIFIED HERE (static, build-side): (a) balanced dollar-quoting — exactly one $$ ... $$ pair (2 '$$' tokens). (b) create or replace function tg_dryer_v2_hourly (1); drop trigger if exists trg_dryer_v2_hourly (1); create trigger trg_dryer_v2_hourly (1) with execute function tg_dryer_v2_hourly() (1) — correct trg_ (trigger) vs tg_ (function) names. (c) byte-identical 030 lines confirmed present: v_src_pk assembly from NEW.log_date::text, event_id md5('dryer_hour|'||v_src_pk||'|'||md5(v_fp)), payload key 'date'=NEW.log_date::text (not transposed), routing label, exception wrapper. (d) npm run build succeeds (vite build, 108 modules, exit 0) — no frontend regression.

ISOLATED-ENVIRONMENT DB CHECKLIST (N1 — CANNOT be run here; manual, non-production Supabase project; cross-ref FEAT-004):
[ ] 1. In a fresh non-production Supabase project, apply migrations in order: 018 (dryer_hourly_draft) -> 030 (dryer_v2 horizontal layout) -> 047 (this migration). Each applies cleanly via SQL Editor with no error.
[ ] 2. Re-run 047 a second time (re-runnability): create or replace function + drop-if-exists/create trigger succeeds idempotently; exactly one trigger trg_dryer_v2_hourly exists on dryer_hourly_draft afterward (SELECT from pg_trigger / information_schema.triggers — no duplicate, firing once per save).
[ ] 3. Genuine edit -> NEW event_id: insert a dryer_hourly_draft row (save), capture its outbox event_id E0; then upsert the SAME (dryer_type, log_date, shift, hour) with one scalar changed and its __hist/__events/__ts grown per FEAT-001. Assert a new outbox row with event_id E1 != E0 exists (new sync event).
[ ] 4. No-op re-save -> SAME event_id: upsert the identical values JSONB again (no changes). Assert md5(v_fp) and thus event_id are unchanged and `on conflict (event_id) do nothing` dedups (no second outbox row for that fingerprint).
[ ] 5. Replay -> SAME event_id: re-serve/re-upsert the identical payload (simulate lost-ack replay). Assert event_id is byte-identical and dedup holds (no duplicate outbox row, no duplicate history).
[ ] 6. Pre-feature backward compat (N2): insert a row whose values has NO __hist and NO __events (030-shape). Assert its event_id is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the value produced by running the same insert under migration 030's function (no #hist suffix on any scalar/maintenance term, no __events term) — i.e. historical rows do not re-sync on deploy.
[ ] 7. Cleared-but-edited field: edit a field value -> '' with __hist[field] present. Assert the field still emits (payload values[field]='', hist[field] present, ts[field] present/grown) and the fingerprint folds v_k=@<new ts>#<len>; (term does not disappear) so event_id changes.
[ ] 8. Maintenance deselect-all: edit maintenance to all-deselected with __hist.maintenance present (v_mhas). Assert maintenance still emits (so the stale cell is cleared), folds its '#'||len term, and hist.maintenance is attached.
[ ] 9. Scope/no-regression: confirm tg_dryer_v2_logs / trg_dryer_v2_logs, the QC triggers, dryer_logs behavior, the unique constraint, RLS, realtime, and the dryer_hourly_draft_active view are unchanged by 047.
